To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the two-step dynamical picture of the multi-particle production process is a consistent and self-consistent general non-equilibrium model for the statistical description of the particle production in hadron-hadron interactions, and that the generalized thermodynamic model of the two-step dynamics can be used for the statistical description for a wide range of energies.

(i) a non-equilibrium formulation for statistical mechanics allows for a dynamical description of the evolution of the state of a system and (ii) this formulation can be used to model multi-particle production.

the dynamical picture of multi-particle production in high energy collisions is a two-step process: first a fast, almost instantaneous, formation of a fireball, followed by its slow decay into the detected particles.
